name: design-engineering
description: Portable design engineering skills for turning product intent into clear interfaces, measured options, and verified UI.

interface.shortDescription: Turn product intent into clear, measured, verified UI.
interface.longDescription: A portable set of design engineering skills for product designers working in code: clarify intent, choose the right UI representation, plan structure and flows, compose from existing primitives, compare measured variants, remove AI slop, and verify the rendered interface.
